preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges of weight 1, m, is between 0 and the minimum of (n*(n-1)//2) and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge is defined by two distinct vertices a_i and b_i, both between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of edges provided matches the given m.

preconditions.expression: len(set((a_i, b_i) for a_i, b_i in edges)) == m

postconditions.description: The weight of the minimum spanning tree is the number of edges of weight 1 minus (n-1), or 0 if negative.
